name: JUICE
best_known_for: ESA's flagship Jupiter mission — Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, the first dedicated study of Ganymede as a habitable world and the first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon
credit: Launched 2023-04-14 on an Ariane 5 ECA+ from Kourou on an 8.5-year cruise (Earth-Venus-Earth-Earth gravity-assist trajectory) to a Jupiter arrival in July 2031. Once in the Jovian system, JUICE makes ~35 flybys of Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto before entering Ganymede orbit in 2034 — the first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon other than Earth's. Ten-instrument payload includes ice-penetrating radar (RIME), submillimetre + sub-mm spectrometer, magnetometer, particle spectrometers, and a laser altimeter. Mission goals: characterise Ganymede + Callisto + Europa as potentially habitable subsurface-ocean worlds, probe the Jovian magnetosphere, and constrain Jupiter's atmosphere and gravity field.
